## 1. Corpus Overview & Architecture

The **Jerry Heuer MAA-NCS Team Contest** is an undergraduate team mathematics competition. The imported PDFs describe a November contest with a three-hour time limit.

- **Corpus Span:** 14 imported contest years (2010–2019, 2022–2025). This collection does not include 2020 or 2021.
- **Structure:** Exactly 10 problems per contest $\implies$ **140 problems total**.
- **Interaction Format:** 100% open-response / mathematical derivation / rigorous proof. There are no multiple-choice options or fill-in questions.
- **Contest Instructions:** The imported problem PDFs specify a three-hour period and prohibit books, notes, calculators, and computers. Consult the PDF for the rules of a particular year.
